notes.title: NEW FUTURE DELUXE UPDATE TEASER! - 📢
notes.notes: [p][/p][previewyoutube="VOao07RPPtA;full"][/previewyoutube][p][b][i]In this teaser, we show you a little bit of the game's new look, locations, lighting, and evolution in the designs.[/i][/b][/p][p]We promised to change everything, be it the gameplay, the visuals, [b]and include a new storyline[/b]. We've listened to many requests and criticism. Now, the minigames will no longer be mandatory and you can follow a new story, with different events and achievements to unlock.[/p][p][/p][h3][b]The update contains more secrets and places to explore. If you haven't purchased the game yet, add it to your wishlist and wait for the next update!![/b][/h3][p][/p]
